definitions_outcome_blind.ACCUMULATION: a downtrend occurred previously; price now ranges/compresses; downside pressure is weakening (defined ONLY by past structure, never by future price direction)
definitions_outcome_blind.DISTRIBUTION: an uptrend occurred previously; price now ranges/compresses; upside pressure is weakening
definitions_outcome_blind.DOWNTREND: a negative causal trend exists now: lower-price structure and measurable downside pressure
definitions_outcome_blind.TRANSITION_UNKNOWN: evidence conflicts, confidence is low, data is insufficient, or the state is changing
definitions_outcome_blind.UPTREND: a positive causal trend exists now: higher-price structure and measurable trend strength
